snippet.title: Sugar Sling Showdown: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: An early prototype version of Sugar sling showdown: where your tongue is your ultimate tool to defend, duel, and explore the whimsical world of Candyland! Catch candies, fling them at foes, and master tongue-powered interactions in this sweet, action-packed adventure.
